problem: Lower-certify the remaining mean-curvature obligation C_mumu(theta)=E_q[(p_theta/p_rho) H_mu] over the full standardized Gaussian null rectangle without the W-tail dependency blow-up seen in the first r88/r89 box attempt.

new_exact_reduction.pointwise_parameter_cell_envelope: For each fixed sufficient-statistic pair (y,W) and parameter cell M=[muL,muU], S=[sigmaL,sigmaU], let dmin be distance from y to M and dmax the farthest endpoint distance. Define Amin=W+m*dmin^2 and Amax=W+m*dmax^2. Because p_theta=sigma^-m exp(-(W+m(y-mu)^2)/(2 sigma^2)), the cell minimum pmin is the smaller endpoint value at Amax, while pmax is attained at sigma=clip(sqrt(Amin/m),S) (with endpoint checks). The denominator p_rho(y,W) is fixed, so Rmin=pmin/p_rho and Rmax=pmax/p_rho are exact pointwise cell envelopes, not independent numerator/denominator W bounds.
new_exact_reduction.curvature_envelope: H_mu=m^2(y-mu)^2/sigma^4-m/sigma^2. Its pointwise cell minimum uses dmin^2 and sigma^2 at the clipped stationary point 2m*dmin^2 or an endpoint. Therefore L_cell(y,W)=Rmin*Hmin when Hmin>=0 and Rmax*Hmin when Hmin<0 satisfies L_cell(y,W)<=R_theta(y,W)H_theta(y) for every theta in the parameter cell. This couples W exactly through the common denominator and eliminates the prior catastrophic W-tail cancellation.
new_exact_reduction.predictive_sampler: The frozen q factorization implies W/4~BetaPrime(31/2,3), and conditional on W, y is Student-t with 37 degrees of freedom and scale sqrt(2*a*(2+W/2)/37). This supplies direct iid samples from q for an independent validation stream.

global_range_for_validation.clipped_X: X=min(L_cell,100), so X is bounded in [-16898.30960396304,100] while E[X]<=E[L_cell]<=C_mumu(theta) for every theta in that cell.

randomized_validation.method: Fresh independent pseudorandom stream; 300000 iid q samples. Partition mu in [0,h] into 16 equal cells and log(sigma) in [log ell,log u] into 16 equal cells. For every one of the 256 cells compute X=min(L_cell,100), then apply the Maurer-Pontil empirical Bernstein lower bound with delta_cell=(1e-6)/256 and union bound across cells.
randomized_validation.result: All 256 parameter-cell simultaneous lower confidence bounds are positive; the minimum is >13.59. This is a strong randomized validation of global C_mumu>0 under the exact pointwise parameter envelope, with much larger margin than the failed independent-W box route.

supporting_public_method.source: Maurer and Pontil (2009), Empirical Bernstein Bounds and Sample Variance Penalization
supporting_public_method.use: One-sided bounded-variable empirical Bernstein radius with sample variance and range; union bound is used over the fixed 256 parameter cells.

additional_derived_result.exact_W_ratio_maximization: For fixed theta,y, p_theta/p_rho as a function of W is B/[A exp(-(b-a)W)+C exp((a-c)W)] after factoring exp(-aW), with b=1/(2 ell^2), c=1/(2 u^2), a=1/(2 sigma^2). The denominator is a sum of one decreasing and one increasing exponential, so its W-minimizer is closed-form. A global numerical search over the compact negative-curvature y/theta region places the exact ratio maximum at about 3.81551, far below the older global 461.25 envelope. This is engineering evidence only until the compact outer maximization is interval-certified.

negative_or_scope_evidence: The >13.59 result is a randomized Monte Carlo confidence certificate conditional on the exact sampler/envelope implementation and pseudorandom stream; it is not a deterministic directed-rounding proof of the integral.
Pointwise envelope arithmetic and special functions used ordinary binary64/scipy. The analytic envelope formulas are exact, but machine-rounding enclosure is still pending.
The compact outer maximization giving ratio≈3.81551 is not used as the confidence-range premise; the older analytic r88 ratio envelope 461.24628 is retained for safety.
All statements remain restricted to the standardized frozen m=32 NIG predictor and iid Gaussian null rectangle.
new_result: The main C_mumu blocker is no longer W-tail dependency. Exact pointwise minimization/maximization over each theta cell produces a uniform lower envelope whose randomized simultaneous integral lower bound is strongly positive over all 256 cells. A deterministic proof can now target only the expectation of this one pointwise envelope, instead of separately interval-bounding q, numerator and mixture denominator over huge W cells.
